premise: forced eviction; hidden-swap-ms not wall clock; Fresh-277 cannot exhibit contention
verdict: INCONCLUSIVE under the frozen bands: the per-key ceiling is 32.1% (kv=3500) and 29.3% (kv=5000) of the budget, inside the 20-50% inconclusive range. The band is NOT moved.

decomposition.headline: About 70% of the prediction budget is unreachable by ANY per-key empirical method. At kv=3500, 945.3 s of the 1392.1 s budget is within-key variance; at kv=5000, 1045.2 s of 1477.6 s. That portion is a property of the workload, not of any estimator.
decomposition.reachable_third_not_reached: The per-key ceiling is 446.8 s and 432.4 s, but the shipped profile-fitted trigger scores 1515.6 s against deadline_only's 1565.4 s at kv=3500, i.e. it LOSES 49.8 s, and gains only 49.8 s at kv=5000. Estimation error is 496.6 s and 382.6 s, larger in both cells than anything the rule actually captures.
decomposition.which_explanation_won: Neither cleanly. The two hypotheses were that per-key evidence does not transfer, or that the key carries no band information. Both hold, in a fixed ratio: roughly 70% of the budget is beyond any per-key method, and essentially all of the remaining 30% is lost to estimation error.

critical_caveat: The per-key ceiling is itself OPTIMISTIC. eval_optimal_trigger is fitted IN-SAMPLE on the very evaluation rows it is scored on, so it overfits each key. The true reachable fraction for an honest per-key method is below 32%, and the 70% unreachable figure is correspondingly a LOWER bound on what is out of reach.
transfers_to_continuum: Continuum's P(tau,f) is a per-key empirical CDF over recorded durations for tool f, verified from the paper's Equation 2. It is a member of exactly the family bounded here. On this workload that class cannot exceed roughly a third of the available budget even with perfect per-key knowledge, and its key (tool name) is coarser than the command-prefix key used here, so its own ceiling is no higher.
key_coverage_note: 1275 of 13410 evaluation rows (9.5%) had no profile-fold support for their key and fell back to the deadline.
